principles: Projection not invention: every rule cites an existing decision doc / mechanism; no new contract.
Anti-drift: cite source-of-truth docs rather than restate; keep AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md copies consistent.
Minimal footprint: docs-only; defer the CLI-hint rewrite and metadata-only specifics.
drivers: Reduce Host mis-operation at DONE convergence.
Do not duplicate proof-admissibility (a committed contract program).
Do not trigger a heavy lifecycle (no high-risk code).

options.name: docs-only runbook (AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md)
pros: Lowest risk/cost: markdown, no material code, no 3x2 floor
Mirrors the established parallel-doc convention (version-bump discipline lives in both files)
Reduces Host mis-operation at DONE convergence immediately
cons: Static doc is read less often than an in-context CLI hint
Two parallel copies must be kept consistent

options.name: also rewrite CLI blocker hints now
pros: Host reads guidance in-context at the moment of confusion (highest leverage)
cons: Touches high-risk lifecycle code (blocker generators) -> full 3x2 review, ~1-2h
Would collide with B-9dfb (in-flight metadata-only dirty-state change)
Rejected for now; defer to a separate story once B-9dfb merges

options.name: single canonical doc + pointers in AGENTS/CLAUDE
cons: Breaks per-Host self-sufficiency (codex reads AGENTS.md, claude reads CLAUDE.md); each must stand alone
Not the repo's established pattern; rejected

rationale: Option A reduces Host confusion at the lowest risk/cost, mirrors the established parallel-doc convention, and cites (not duplicates) the proof-admissibility / storyFilesHash / done_prepare / floor decision docs. B is deferred (high-risk lifecycle code + B-9dfb overlap); C breaks per-Host self-sufficiency since each Host reads only its own instructions file.

preMortem.trigger: It restates rules that later change (proof-admissibility warn->enforce, or B-9dfb changes metadata-only dirty-state handling).
preMortem.consequence: Host follows an outdated rule and mis-operates.
preMortem.mitigation: Cite the decision docs as source of truth rather than restating; frame the materialHash-only downgrade as a 'current warn/advisory projection'; reference metadata-only handling as a pointer to B-9dfb instead of hardcoding it.

preMortem.scenario: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md copies diverge over time.
preMortem.trigger: A future edit updates only one file.
preMortem.consequence: codex and claude Hosts receive different DONE discipline.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep both copies byte-aligned in substance (mirror the existing version-bump parallel-doc convention); the docs reviewer checks cross-file consistency.

preMortem.trigger: The runbook cites a lattice command that is stale or renamed vs the registry.
preMortem.consequence: The story cannot advance to TEST.
preMortem.mitigation: Reference only verified commands (done_prepare --help confirmed) and the 4 existing decision docs; run the docs-drift preflight before advancing.
